claim: Stresa to Villa Crespi in Orta San Giulio is roughly 14 miles (~22 km) and about 23 minutes by car.
quote: The driving distance between Stresa to Relais & Chateaux Villa Crespi, Orta San Giulio is 14 miles. It takes approximately 23 minutes to drive from Stresa to Relais & Chateaux Villa Crespi, Orta San Giulio.

claim: Isola Bella's Palazzo Borromeo opens for the 2026 season from 12 March to 8 November, with adult tickets at €25 plus a €0.50 landing fee.
quote: Isola Bella is open from March 12 to November 8, 2026... Adults pay €25, while children (6-15 years) pay €16. There is also a €0.50 landing fee per person payable on the spot.

claim: Navigazione Laghi runs Lake Maggiore ferries on the summer timetable from 29 March to 4 October 2026, with departures roughly every 30 minutes in the Borromean bay from around 08:00 to 18:00.
quote: The summer timetable for Lake Maggiore valid from 29th March to 4th October 2026 is currently in effect.

claim: Isola Madre's 8-hectare botanical gardens are among Italy's oldest, laid out in English style in the late 18th century, with a famed Piazzale dei Pappagalli featuring free-roaming parrots, peacocks and pheasants.
quote: One of the oldest botanical gardens in Italy, the present English garden-style park was landscaped in the early 19th century... Piazzale dei Pappagalli - parrots, peacocks, pheasants, etc.

claim: Isola dei Pescatori is the only permanently inhabited Borromean island, a small fishermen's village (~100x350 m) packed with seafood trattorias and balconied houses once used for drying fish.
quote: The island's old town is a walkable warren with heaps of fairytale appeal, historic architecture, crisscrossing alleyways, and a surprisingly large collection of restaurants serving fresh seafood and hearty Piedmont cuisine paired with mountain views.

claim: The Consorzio Motoscafisti Isole Borromee runs smaller private motorboats (37 seats, partly open) alongside the public Navigazione Laghi service for island hopping from Stresa.
quote: Modern boats with all mod cons, microphone, and music diffusion that are partially open for sunny days and completely covered in case of rain, with each boat carrying 37 seated people plus the crew.

claim: Navigazione Laghi public ferries are the cheaper, schedule-reliable option with easier boarding via ramps, while the private motoscafisti board from a narrower pier slightly north.
quote: The Municipal Ferry operates larger, white ferry boats with 132 person capacity that dock using loading ramps at the main and island piers, and run on published ferry schedules with cheap, prompt, and efficient hop-on, hop-off service.

claim: Stresa's Corso Umberto I lakefront promenade is lined with Belle Époque grand hotels and villas with Alp views across the lake.
quote: The lungolago—the lakefront promenade that stretches endlessly along the water's edge features grand dames of architecture, all Belle Époque façades and wrought iron balconies.

claim: The Grand Hotel des Iles Borromées, open since 1863 with a preserved Belle Époque interior, is the most iconic of Stresa's historic lakefront hotels.
quote: The most prominent hotel is the Grand Hotel des Iles Borromées, which has been the place to stay since 1863, featuring a Belle Époque façade with salons and rooms that preserve the shimmering chandeliers, rich fabrics and timeless elegance of a bygone era.

claim: A combined Isola Bella + Isola Madre ticket is around €36.50 in 2026, separate from the Navigazione Laghi day ferry pass which costs about €16.90.
quote: The combined ticket for Isola Madre + Isola Bella costs €36.50... The ferry day ticket costs €16.90 for adults.

claim: The Stresa–Alpino–Mottarone cable car from Piazzale Lido in Carciano has remained closed since the fatal 23 May 2021 accident, with no confirmed reopening for 2026.
quote: The aerial tramway has remained closed ever since the Stresa-Mottarone cable car disaster on 23 May 2021.

claim: From Monday 4 May 2026 the Lake Maggiore timetable adds services 142 and 143 on the Stresa–Islands–Baveno route, while Campione stops are suspended from 16 May 2026.
quote: With effect from Monday 4 May, the timetable will be updated to include services 142 and 143 on the Stresa – Islands – Baveno and Baveno – Stresa routes... All stops to Campione are suspended from 16th May 2026.
